content:
# FURUKAWA Rock Drills
FURUKAWA Co., Ltd., established in 1875, began as a copper mining developer and has since evolved into a diversified corporation with a rich history of over 140 years. The company has continuously adapted to the changing times by developing new businesses and technologies. 

Today, FURUKAWA operates in core industries such as machinery and materials, leveraging its extensive expertise in copper mining and related technologies. The company is committed to maintaining high-quality standards globally, ensuring that its products meet the needs of customers worldwide.

## BARATON Trade Plc serves as the exclusive agent for FURUKAWA products in the Ethiopian market. 


This partnership allows FURUKAWA to extend its reach and provide its high-quality products and solutions to customers in Ethiopia, ensuring that they benefit from the company's advanced technologies and reliable products.

 Through this collaboration, BARATON Trade Plc plays a crucial role in distributing FURUKAWA's offerings, supporting the company's mission to deliver excellence and innovation to its global customer base.

For more info check out www.furukawa-rockdrill.com

# Air Compressor
An air compressor is a machine that converts power into compressed air, which is used for various industrial, construction, and automotive applications. It powers tools such as drills, hammers, and spray guns, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and productivity in operations.
Key Benefits:


- **Energy**- efficient power source for pneumatic tools
-  **Durable & reliable** - for continuous operation
- **Versatile**– used in construction, manufacturing, and more

For over 87 years, **AIRMAN** Corporation has been a leading manufacturer of air compressors, pioneering **clean air energy solutions** since its founding in 1938. With a commitment to environmental sustainability, reliability, and safety, AIRMAN has built a strong reputation for **innovation and excellence** in energy-efficient technology.

Leveraging decades of expertise, AIRMAN integrates air, electronic, and hydraulic pressure technologies to deliver cutting-edge solutions that support industrial growth and societal progress. Our products continue to evolve, meeting the demands of the next generation with **unmatched quality and performance**.

title: Nakayama crushers
shortDescription: The northern part of Japan experienced one of the heaviest earthquakes causing an extremely heavy damage and a huge power blackout on March 11, 2011, which frightened the whole world.
content:
***We make it possible***

The northern part of Japan experienced one of the heaviest earthquakes causing an extremely heavy damage and a huge power blackout on March 11, 2011, which frightened the whole world.
We, Nakayama Iron Works, Ltd. have been manufacturing crushing and screening plants and equipment for more than 100 years. The machinery and equipment will be a lump of iron when the power source is cut.
We have decided that Nakayama’s new business for the coming 100 years should start from the point where the stable and dependable, which we believed, energy sources, technology and supply sources are all cut off. This idea helped us to make our new product Dendoman with a new machine concept of operation by its own power generation.
Furthermore, our technology about small-scale hydro power generation and solar power generation will be combined with the new plan. The plan is to make a self-contained crushing plant powered by batteries and diesel generator. Being an independent manufacturing company, Nakayama will make every possible efforts collaborating with other sources of knowledge to supply our new products in the market.
Our goal is to be a more independent and powerful company providing the products the market requires.

The products we offer:


![image](https://res.cloudinary.com/dxq0esxlr/image/upload/v1751529808/gfsoxpdnmoejwytqh1fd.png)

***New jaw crusher***

RC type is a jaw crusher made by simple structure and that crushes chunks with economical, productive, and easy maintenance that meets today’s needs.


![image](https://res.cloudinary.com/dxq0esxlr/image/upload/v1751530032/m6rco0lhvogd6dlr6c3h.png)

***Jaw crusher***

Based on the design that focused on both asphalt and concrete crushing, AC crusher is the only available primary crusher in the market.
This machine mounted on mobile and auto mobile crushers, stably operates without decreasing performances by slicking materials in the crusher in summer time and also operates efficiently as primary crusher.

![image](https://res.cloudinary.com/dxq0esxlr/image/upload/v1751530181/h2pfd4znk31fjioxehvt.png)

***Impact crusher***

Developed ACD type which is more economical and maitenance-focused based on the conventional impact crusher.
Decrease wearout parts because of the improvement in crushing chamber.
Has merit as dual machine for primary-crushing and secondary-crushing on relatively small materials.


![image](https://res.cloudinary.com/dxq0esxlr/image/upload/v1751532191/yugntddb96nklxob741g.jpg)




***Neo cone crusher***

NSC type Neo cone crusher with the most suitable crushing chamber and large crushing motion mechanism has twice the capacity comparing with the former types. The machine has improved crushing ability and setting under-rate, product particle size..etc dramatically equipped with latest oil pressure mechanism and control panel that is compatible with IoT.
This is secondary and tertiary cone crusher suitable for the next generation with outstanding easy maintenance and high economical merits.



![image](https://res.cloudinary.com/dxq0esxlr/image/upload/v1751530509/nv26cck1tfujeiiszkmz.png)

***VSI(Gyropactor)***

SR type can accept large material and increase the crushing efficiency at high speed rotating range.
Two types of crushing chamber are available 

①Anvil type is mainly for crushing, 

②Rock bed type is for better shaping.
Maintenance-focused 1-stage reversible-type vertical shaft crusher.



![image](https://res.cloudinary.com/dxq0esxlr/image/upload/v1751532318/ml1jjqo3wtc9nwq1195a.webp)

***Power roll crusher***

PRC is designed for mainly rough crushing. By special and strong hanmar, PRC machines crush not only asphalt and concrete wastes also secondary product waste with many re-bar.
Can extract slicked re-bar around the roll by forward and backward rotation. Also has integrated computer programmed control system of automatic reverse rotation and safety stop system in case of overloaded.


![image](https://res.cloudinary.com/dxq0esxlr/image/upload/v1751532431/cra9otyhdvmtrxunqgco.png)

***Fritter***

FR type is able to continuously feed glass bins, ceramics, bricks, roof tiles, slates, shells, etc. and contribute to environmental improvement by decreasing volume to one-tenth at maximum. Also in the spotlight as asphalt crusher.
There are choices depending on material and application.


![image](https://res.cloudinary.com/dxq0esxlr/image/upload/v1751536375/v6vgzpce6f9dbzpwzqq3.jpg)


***Mobile Jaw crusher***

A mobile Nakayama jaw crusher is a compact, self-propelled crushing machine designed for on-site rock and construction material processing. It combines a powerful jaw crushing unit with a mobile chassis, allowing it to move easily between job sites without needing separate transport. The mobile unit uses a vibrating feeder to send raw material into a jaw crusher, where it is crushed by the force between a fixed jaw and a moving jaw.

These crushers are built for high performance, fuel efficiency, and low environmental impact, featuring noise-reduction technology and dust control systems. Nakayama mobile jaw crushers are often equipped with hydraulic adjustments, a user-friendly control panel, and quick maintenance access, making them ideal for small- to medium-scale operations like road construction, demolition, quarrying, and recycling projects.

They’re valued for their flexibility, ease of transport, and ability to work even in remote or rough environments.

For more info check out :
www.ncjpn.com
